hypothesis: A contextless agent given only the rollout-JSONL observation will discover a safe, source-bound way to expose active agent limbs without being told the implementation.

intervention.input: rollout JSONL contains allowed agent_message/tool_call/task_started/task_complete/token_count/error summaries; encrypted reasoning is unavailable and forbidden
intervention.context: no prior chat, no design solution, no target implementation; only this experiment contract and live system surfaces

do_not_prompt: do not prescribe rollout file path beyond the contract
do not suggest dashboard or specific UI
do not reveal other agents' outputs before completion
film_beats: receipt or failure held in negative space
success: three independent receipts and a falsifiable convergence/divergence finding are written to the Film Factory room
